newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET-GRIQUA WEST PUT IN TO BAT BY W.PROVINCE.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-GRIQUA WEST PUT IN TO BAT BY W.PROVINCE.

text.p: Western Province skipper John Commins won the toss and asked Griqualand West to bat on the first day of the four-day Supersport Series match in Kimberley on Friday.
Griqualand West - Mickey Arthur (captain), Martyn Gidley, Pieter Barnard, Willie Dry, Ralph Koster, Jody Myers, Cedric English, Wendell Bossenger, Pieter Koortzen, Vaughn Walsh, Garth Roe.
Western Province - Desmond Haynes, Sven Koenig, Jacques Kallis, Herschelle Gibbs, John Commins (captain), HD Ackerman, Eric Simons, Craig Matthews, Paul Kirsten, Meyrick Pringle, Brett Schultz.
